% Pattern: number/numexpr. A paper numbers from zero with a command whose body
% is \the\numexpr, used in \thesection and \thetheorem. Seen in the gold pilot
% (set X).
% want theorem-1 statement/theorem 0.0 status=none
% want lemma-1 statement/lemma 0.1 status=none
% want lemma-2 statement/lemma 1.0 status=none
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsthm}
\def\zbased#1{\the\numexpr(\arabic{#1})-1\relax}
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}[section]
\newtheorem{lemma}[theorem]{Lemma}
\renewcommand\thesection{\zbased{section}}
\renewcommand\thetheorem{\thesection.\zbased{theorem}}
\begin{document}
\section{Introduction}
\begin{theorem} Every compact space is bounded. \end{theorem}
\begin{lemma} Every closed subset of a compact space is compact. \end{lemma}
\section{Products}
\begin{lemma} Every finite product of compact spaces is compact. \end{lemma}
\end{document}
